أنهمك (form VII)
# أَنْهَمِكُ (ʔanhamiku) /ʔan.ha.mi.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# أَنْهَمِكَ (ʔanhamika) /ʔan.ha.mi.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# أَنْهَمِكْ (ʔanhamik) /ʔan.ha.mik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
